display_long_description:
Jurassic World: Aftermath

Welcome to "Jurassic World: Aftermath," a thrilling VR game that plunges players into the heart of a dinosaur-infested jungle, testing their survival skills against the most formidable creatures ever to walk the Earth. Set in the aftermath of the catastrophic events at Jurassic World, players find themselves stranded in an overgrown, abandoned research facility on Isla Nublar. The once state-of-the-art labs and attractions are now in ruins, reclaimed by nature and prowled by predatory dinosaurs.

Game Overview:

In "Jurassic World: Aftermath," you assume the role of a skilled survivor tasked with a daring mission to retrieve vital research data left behind after the park's collapse. Equipped with limited resources and cutting-edge VR technology, players must navigate through dense foliage, dilapidated buildings, and dark, treacherous environments while evading the relentless pursuit of dinosaurs.
